response.original_title: Li Jin Hao: Swimming in a Submarine
response.overview: Hot off the heels of his sell out debut hour at Edinburgh, Li Jin Hao walks you through the seascape of his mind, filled with nightmares of being a spider, dreams of joining the yakuza and breezy memories of serving in the military with the boys.
response.title: Li Jin Hao: Swimming in a Submarine
